subject: [hw] T02 -> IK: phone test files are written; point INTEGRATION.md at tests/phone/README.md
body:
Answer to your earlier request: point INTEGRATION.md at gpu/hwcodec/tests/phone/README.md (overview + boot lines) and the per-milestone files 00-preflight.md, 10-jpeg.md, 20-vcodec-readonly.md, 30-venc-power.md, 40-daemon-encode.md (daemon pending hw-ip/hw-p03 names), 50-recovery.md. Do not invent commands; these are the exact ones.

Guest runner (installed by the main session at /usr/local/bin/n2hw_phone_tests):
  STAGE=preflight|jpeg|vcodec|daemon|all /usr/local/bin/n2hw_phone_tests
  cat /var/tmp/n2hw/results.txt
It needs rwvc_probe (tests/phone/rwvc_probe.c, build with libSystem; /usr/local/bin/rwvc_probe), rwjpeg_tool (J02), optionally vcodecd/n2vcd_cli. It writes one PASS/FAIL/SKIP line per test and ends N2HW PHONE PASS n/n or FAIL n/n.

Read-only K side (matches your 0299 facts):
  /usr/local/bin/rwvc_probe info      -> N2VC info abi=1 powered=0x0 ... irq_mode=0 server=0; no register
  /usr/local/bin/rwvc_probe client    -> minor 1: INFO, SEND no server ENXIO, RECV timeout 0 EAGAIN, POWER/REGS EACCES; no register
  /usr/local/bin/rwvc_probe all       -> each block on/read one word/off (K02 power + first read)
  /usr/local/bin/rwvc_probe read      -> VENC on, read 0x00/0x04/0x5c/0x60/0x100/0x104, off
Pass = last line N2VC verdict PASS and no NORD2 VCODEC: error line. The exact expected stdout is in 20/30-*.md.

Host wrapper (never flashes/resets; needs the main session exec path):
  PHONE_EXEC="ssh root@nord2" bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/phone/run_phone_tests.sh q10hw2 all
If PHONE_EXEC is unset it prints the guest commands and exits 2; it does not guess how you reach the phone.

J side: rwjpeg_tool info / selftest / bench 1920x1080 30 / pattern 640x480 / enc ... as in 10-jpeg.md, last line N2JPG selftest 640x480 PASS 12/12. Do not run it concurrently with hwc.py command 7 (shared VEN model).
